column1: # CPU-only CERTA timing next to the GPU pipeline (2026-10-16; galaxy, Ampere Altra 128 cores, 64 threads per pipeline; GPU runs also use one A100, device 1).
# Build ~/certa-prof4 = commit 474ad90. 20,001,073 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs; SAM and fallback output discarded. Script: galaxy:~/certa-bench/cpu/run_cpu.sh.
# certa-cpu-pipe / certa-cpu-pe-pipe: CERTA without --gpu (certa_threads) streaming its uncertified reads or pairs into minibwa (64 - certa_threads), as run_bench.sh / run_bench_pe.sh do for the GPU.
# certa-cpu-tier: CERTA alone on 64 threads, certified reads only (94.38 % certified, as on the GPU); not a complete mapping.
# Rows 2-11: thread-split scan (one run each); then minibwa, the GPU pipe and the CPU pipe at its best split in one session, three times each; then the paired runs.
